correction: Matched diversity recomputed on 2026-09-16 with length-bin matching. The original run matched exact integer lengths, which left only 2 of 233 lengths populated in all four arms and starved the comparison to 9 structures per arm with a ratio pinned at 1.0 by construction. Inputs, clustering edges and every other field are unchanged; only the matching and its reported ceiling differ.
